articles.title: Lanterns Clips Spotlight Chandler's Hal Jordan: Charmer & Interrogator
articles.summary: HBO's upcoming 'Lanterns' series, starring Kyle Chandler as Hal Jordan and Aaron Pierre, has released new clips. These clips showcase 'two very different sides' of Chandler's portrayal of the iconic character. The show is expected to delve into the expansive science fiction universe of the Green Lantern Corps, exploring its advanced technology and intergalactic themes. This adaptation brings a fresh perspective.

articles.title: CAS imbroglio: NSE clarifies all is well
articles.summary: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) clarified its Closing Auction Session implementation, stating it was introduced under SEBI's guidance. This initiative aims to bolster transparency and facilitate fair and robust price discovery within the market. For SSB aspirants, understanding such regulatory frameworks highlights India's commitment to strengthening financial integrity and investor confidence, crucial aspects of national economic stability.

articles.title: Do balls float or sink in water?
articles.summary: This article explains the fundamental principles of buoyancy and density, which determine whether an object floats or sinks in water. It clarifies that some balls float while others sink based on their individual density in relation to the fluid. Understanding this relationship is key to comprehending how objects behave in liquids, a core concept in physics.
